g.text: The page will not load. Where do you look first?
not in the list? -> docker ps -a + docker logs
unhealthy? -> it is Up but broken, read the logs
true / Exited (137)? -> the memory limit killed it
Always work top-down. Most 'Docker is broken' reports are one of these four, and every one of them is answered by a command you already know from LAB 1.
